rubric.note: All route/region/width/theme cells captured; status includes words; one primary offer action and no destructive or editable state. Extra text stress is F1; device/browser limitations are explicit.

D23 decides route/vocabulary, voice, history and capacity changes; D14/D19 govern the current places. M1 dates remain adjacent; language switches preserve place (M2/W3). Older S-1 quality debt remains F6.
Native links, current-page state, working bilingual recovery, honest statuses and traceable internal navigation. There is no hidden mutable state.
Real navigation clicks with before/300ms/after strips; skip links reach main on every content route; ordinary/reduced arrival keeps main visible.

No observed normal-size clipping at 320/390/1440. Keyboard skip and native navigation work. The extra computed-font stress overflow is major F1, not a claimed browser-zoom WCAG result; browser-menu zoom and hardware remain unverified.
No appearance toggle, UUID, tracker, third-party font or newly disclosed athlete identity. Selma remains one CV line per company language. Finnish editorial content is outside reviewer scope.
Production build and independent matrix capture succeeded. Fresh ds gate findings are recorded in gate.json; no claim of a fresh Lighthouse performance run is made by this review.
New product routes, redirect targets, language pairs, sitemap, history blocks and every requested content removal match D23. Removed content leaves no empty sections.
Tuohi hierarchy, type, bark, rules and footer identity remain coherent. F6 carries the inherited actual-product-screen shortfall; F2 identifies minor status-grid polish.

All 104 present and 16 deleted baselines visually inspected through full-page sheets; paired browser-locale files verified byte-identical. Every changed path is approved by exact current SHA-256 or deleted.

findings.message: Extra computed-font-200% stress at desktop width pushes product status/date content beyond the viewport on both home and products routes in both themes: 39 px FI and 68 px EN. Make the status grid adapt to enlarged text, or switch it to the existing stacked layout; preserve approved text. This is a synthetic text-only quality check, not a browser-menu zoom conformance failure.

At 1440 px the product status separator/date label is an anonymous grid item, starting a second row beneath the lenticel while the date occupies the next cell. Group the date metadata as one layout unit so the separator and label stay visually attached; no copy change is requested.

Carried forward from c4cc619c F6: the front page shows product names, purposes and honest dated statuses, but no actual product screen. The S-1 visual proof ambition remains unfulfilled; add an authorized, appropriately labelled real product capture at the design milestone.
